description: CapMeta build-metadata tool (no Linode API call). Every field is a build constant except platform, which reports the running host's own OS and architecture, so platform is declared host-decided and pinned by pattern while the rest stays a literal. commit reads "unknown" in both languages: a development build knows no commit, and saying so beats naming a build type nobody chose.

host_decided.reason: the running host's own OS and architecture, so no literal holds on both a developer machine and the CI container
